verdict.rationale: Poly's agent can run multi-step tasks from a single request (poly-docs-14), the docs say you can 'automate tasks like organizing a folder' (poly-docs-31), and agents can spawn and track subagents (poly-docs-35). The scriptable `poly` CLI (poly-docs-17) suggests background runs are possible with outside tools such as a scheduler, but the evidence describes on-request agent work, not user-configured automations that run unattended. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automations, documented background or unattended execution, an automation setup UI or config, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
